title: Nebulous Cosmic Birth
description: A turbulent abstract cosmic scene featuring swirling clouds of vibrant nebulae in purple, red, and orange on the left, contrasting with teal and turquoise formations on the right. A dark central void contains multiple glowing golden circular rings and particles floating within the inky blackness.
